exposure: Sociodemographic factors (age, race/ethnicity, insurance status, socioeconomic status)
living in a high poverty ZIP code
outcome: Postpartum hospital use (emergency department visit or hospital readmission within 90 days of birth admission discharge)
finding: Birth complications, preexisting and pregnancy-related conditions, undergoing cesarean birth, younger maternal age, non-Hispanic Black race, low socioeconomic status, and having Medicaid were significantly associated with increased likelihood of postpartum hospital use.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth complications were significantly associated with postpartum hospital use.
